rule: Not calls: passing a method reference (`x::m`, `self.m` without call), enum-variant/data construction (...), casts, language constructs (...), declarations/function heads, module attributes, typespecs, field access without a call.
notes: call_type convention (SPEC names the six call_types but does not define direct vs method): a call with no written receiver is direct; a call with a written receiver (obj., this., super., a type name) is method; new/super(...)/this(...) are constructor. No edges for: `@Deprecated` (annotation, line 9), `this::print` (11), `String::valueOf` (12), `Refs::noop` (17) — method references; `(String) o` (13) — cast; `this.x` (14) and `p.x` (16) — field access; the declarations themselves. Point has no written constructor; `new Point()` is high because Point is in the scan (see 02 notes).
